# How fast a rule may change

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`how-fast-a-rule-may-change` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](how-fast-a-rule-may-change.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A rule that never reads the fast level is unreached and loses what it merges; a fast difference reaches a rule only at a reading step. Given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of held courses with at most N states exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A two-level course, the fast configuration stepping by a rule that changes only at reading steps, is a run of one law; a rule that never reads is kept, nothing the fast level meets reaches it, and under it what is lost stays lost and merges lose configurations. (`Becoming.Pace.paced`, `Becoming.Pace.paced_run`, `Becoming.Pace.rule_kept`, `Becoming.Pace.rule_unreached`, `Becoming.Pace.never_reads_lost`, `Becoming.Pace.never_reads_merged`, `Becoming.Pace.never_reads_loses`, `Becoming.Pace.byRule_reabsorbed`)
2. A fast difference reaches the rule only at a reading step: up to and including the first reading step the rule is the one at the start, exact in Copying; regaining what a fixed rule loses needs a change of rule (Switching). (`Becoming.Pace.rule_until_reading`, `Becoming.Pace.rule_alike_until_reading`, `Becoming.Pace.rule_at_reading`, `Becoming.Copying.rule_parts`, `Becoming.Switching.fixed_loses`, `Becoming.Switching.changing_regains`)
3. Given two values, a stretch of L steps fixes every pair of courses with at most N states that held rules generate exactly when L ≥ 2N − 1: shorter stretches dissolve (from prefix_short_twice), longer ones fix (from bounded_agree); within a paced course a rule held that long is fixed over its stretch. (`Becoming.Pace.heldCourse`, `Becoming.Pace.held_statesBelow`, `Becoming.Pace.held_realizes`, `Becoming.Pace.dissolving`, `Becoming.Pace.held_fixed`, `Becoming.Pace.stretch_fixed`, `Becoming.Pace.StretchFixes`, `Becoming.Pace.pace_law`)
4. A course of configurations read whole, with at most N states, is fixed among every run of every law by its first N + 1 steps, exactly. (`Becoming.Pace.whole_fixed`, `Becoming.Pace.whole_fixed_exact`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; the fast law, the reading law and the reading steps are given; courses with at most N states are read through a map; the pace law quantifies over fast levels in Type, the fixing side in every universe.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which rule a slow level reads into, that it reads at stretches of any length, or how many states an actual fast level has.
- That a layered pace is better than another; many levels and rules that change by chance.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
